## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or gameplay mode
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix in audio, rhyme matching, or UI
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `style`: Code style or cosmetic UI adjustments
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization with no behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Unit, integration, or E2E tests added/updated
- [ ] `data`: Changes to Darija phonetic rules, rhyme dictionaries, or beat catalog
- [ ] `chore`: CI/CD, dependency updates, or tooling
